title: Mallards Along the Water's Edge
caption:
MALLARDS ON THE MOVE. Genuine separately filmed park, river and duckling moments. #WildVox #Mallard #Wildlife

narration_timeline.text: Several mallards glide together on a park pond, cutting small ripples through the surface.
narration_timeline.scene: Visible group of mallards swimming together in an Oulu park.

narration_timeline.text: Another group follows the edge of a city waterway, passing slowly through the current.
narration_timeline.scene: Adult mallards moving on Ljubljana Prule waterway.

narration_timeline.text: Winter recordings show the ducks changing direction and approaching different sections of shore.
narration_timeline.scene: Two real mallard clips on different Ljubljana river dates.

narration_timeline.text: At another pond, their broad bills hover near the water as they investigate the bank.
narration_timeline.scene: Mallards on a pond in Drage; webbed feet explained but not claimed visible.

narration_timeline.text: Some ducks keep paddling through the cold water, while others drift a little farther.
narration_timeline.scene: Adult mallards moving in Ljubljana winter waterway.

narration_timeline.text: Two separate recordings show young ducks near adults, reminding us how early they begin to swim.
narration_timeline.scene: Actual mallard ducklings near bank and separate USFWS adult-with-young footage.
